item.title: Budget 2026: Hong Kong to form new AI strategy committee chaired by finance chief Paul Chan

item.description: The Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB)’s 22-year-old harbour light show will be replaced, finance chief Paul Chan told lawmakers on Wednesday. item.title: Budget 2026: Hong Kong economy forecast to grow 3.5% as deficit streak ends
item.description: Hong Kong’s economy is expected to grow up to 3.5 per cent as government coffers return to a surplus following a streak of deficits, Financial Secretary Paul Chan has announced in his 2026 budget speech.
